name: talent-one
description: One role brief in, a full hiring package out. A per-role Context Pack, nine artifact specialists, a scout that builds the pack, a REFUTE critic, a QA gate and an orchestrator that runs the loop. Rendered as branded HTML with sourced market data. Also carries an Oracle funnel diagnosis, a Prompt Forge helper and a headless runner. Built from the talent-one module of onepromptman/talentai; the paste-in and n8n editions are published as onepromptman/dag-talent-agents.
